An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 809 identities would post 4616 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
